schema: Each idea: id, kind (core|feature|polish), name, pitch (one line), closest (existing game), new (what's novel), scores (R1..R14 per docs/research/RUBRIC.md, 0-2; 'est' until measured), value (1-10), effort (1-10), status (backlog|shortlisted|prototyped|chosen|rejected|merged|built), reason.

ideas.name: Hollow (loop clear)
ideas.pitch: Close a loop of blocks and everything inside it pops.
ideas.closest: Block Blast + Go capture + Two Dots squares
ideas.new: Enclosure replaces line clears; holes — the genre's core fear — become the way you score.
ideas.reason: Chosen (ADR 0001). Only candidate passing every gate on measured data; huge planning headroom; big loops form a visible jackpot.
ideas.data: hollow8-ramp2: median moves random/firstFit/greedy/search 17/27/80/488; score skill 53.7×; firstFit÷search 0.03, greedy÷search 0.12; 2.2 moves/clear; median best pocket 19 cells. R4=1: greedy sessions too long until ramp is tuned. R2 needs a scripted first tray (pocket in 2 moves).

ideas.name: Skid (slide-in)
ideas.pitch: Flick blocks in from the edge; they slide until they hit something.
ideas.new: Per-piece choice of 4 gravity directions; you must build stoppers to place anywhere.
ideas.reason: Rejected after prototype: shallow ceiling (search survives 25 moves), and deaths happen with half the board empty because big pieces cannot reach open space — feels unfair.

ideas.name: Flip (XOR stamp)
ideas.pitch: Every block flips the tiles it lands on.
ideas.new: Pieces can land anywhere; overlaps cancel; full lines clear. Also yields a provably-solvable puzzle mode.
ideas.reason: Rejected as core after prototype: greedy ≈ search (0.96) → no planning depth; random play never clears; the board turns into unreadable checkerboard noise. Puzzle mode (I-041) remains a backlog idea.

ideas.name: Exact Count
ideas.pitch: Each row and column clears when it holds exactly its number.
ideas.new: Clear condition is an exact count, not 'full'; overshooting a line kills it until a crossing line clears.
ideas.reason: Rejected: lines clear too easily, games never end for greedy/search; greedy ≈ search (0.90–0.94) → shallow. Numbers add reading load.

ideas.name: Overgrowth (growing tray)
ideas.pitch: Every piece you skip grows one block.
ideas.new: Tray pieces are alive: waiting makes them bigger, so timing which piece to use becomes the decision.
ideas.reason: Plays like the baseline (search 92 vs 125 moves); the twist lives in the tray, not on the board → weak novelty. Kept as possible Hollow modifier.

ideas.name: Pickup
ideas.pitch: Drop a piece onto blocks and you pick those blocks up as your next piece.
ideas.new: Placement is always possible; covered cells become a new tray piece in their shape.
ideas.reason: Picked-up shapes can be disconnected 'constellations' that read poorly; fail state is muddy. Closed in session 2: an alternative core rule; the game keeps exactly one rule (hard constraint).

ideas.name: Rain Cups
ideas.pitch: Build cups; when rain fills one, it washes away.
ideas.new: Side-view board; open-top enclosures hold water; full cups clear.
ideas.reason: Gorgeous theme but floating blocks in a side view conflict with water gravity; siphon edge cases. Possible theme for Hollow instead. Closed in session 2: an alternative core rule; the game keeps exactly one rule (hard constraint).

ideas.name: Mirror
ideas.pitch: Everything you place is reflected across the mirror.
ideas.new: Each placement stamps twice (axis changes per tray); symmetry both helps and blocks.
ideas.reason: Likely collapses to 'half-board Block Blast'; depth suspect. Closed in session 2: an alternative core rule; the game keeps exactly one rule (hard constraint).

ideas.name: Region Pop
ideas.pitch: Fill a colored region to pop it.
ideas.new: Irregular pastel regions instead of lines; regions re-tile after clearing.
ideas.reason: Fails novelty gate: a literal fusion of the two reference games.

ideas.name: Cash Out
ideas.pitch: Full lines wait for you; tap to cash them — more at once pays more.
ideas.reason: Two verbs (drag + tap); fails one-sentence gate. Push-your-luck emerges naturally in Hollow instead.

ideas.name: Collapse
ideas.pitch: When a line clears, the board closes the gap.
ideas.new: Rows and columns both collapse toward the cleared line → cascades.
ideas.reason: Cascades are fun but it reads as Tetris-gravity; novelty gate partial. Closed in session 2: an alternative core rule; the game keeps exactly one rule (hard constraint).

ideas.name: Melt
ideas.pitch: Blocks melt five turns after you place them.
ideas.new: Board self-clears; you race melting to complete lines.
ideas.reason: Fails one-move gate (effect appears only after 5 turns); timer-like anxiety.

ideas.name: Corner Chain
ideas.pitch: Each piece must touch the last one only at a corner.
ideas.reason: Rule needs explaining; Blokus-derived.

ideas.name: Chain Touch
ideas.pitch: Every piece must touch the one before it.
ideas.new: Placement constraint creates a snake of pieces.
ideas.reason: A restriction, not an idea; makes Block Blast worse.

ideas.name: Square Pop
ideas.pitch: Any filled square, 3×3 or bigger, pops.
ideas.new: Squares anywhere at any size, not fixed boxes.
ideas.reason: Solid but feels like a Woodoku variant. Could be a Hollow 'bonus shape' later. Closed in session 2: an alternative core rule; the game keeps exactly one rule (hard constraint).

ideas.name: Mono Rect
ideas.pitch: Any solid one-color rectangle pops.
ideas.reason: Color RNG dominates; rare rewards.

ideas.name: Shove
ideas.pitch: Dropped blocks shove their neighbors; anything pushed off the edge is gone.
ideas.reason: Fun chaos but outcomes are hard to preview; fairness risk. Closed in session 2: an alternative core rule; the game keeps exactly one rule (hard constraint).

ideas.name: Bookends
ideas.pitch: Trap a line of blocks between two of the same color to clear it.
ideas.new: Color sandwich clears instead of full lines.
ideas.reason: Needs explanation; color luck.

ideas.name: Cluster Pop
ideas.pitch: Six touching blocks of one color pop.
ideas.reason: Derivative of Puyo/match-3 hybrids that exist.

ideas.name: Torus
ideas.pitch: The board wraps around its edges.
ideas.reason: Rule is invisible; wrapped pieces read badly.

ideas.name: Dartboard
ideas.pitch: Fill a ring or a spoke on a round board to clear it.
ideas.reason: Pieces bend around rings → unreadable silhouettes; a grid skin.

ideas.name: Kaleidoscope
ideas.pitch: Each piece also appears rotated around the center.
ideas.reason: Merged into I-008 as a variant.

ideas.name: Punch Out
ideas.pitch: Punch shapes out of a full board; empty a row to score.
ideas.reason: Mathematically isomorphic to Block Blast (complement board).

ideas.name: Freehand
ideas.pitch: Draw any shape of the size you're given.
ideas.new: Tray gives sizes, you choose shapes by tracing.
ideas.reason: Freedom removes the constraint that makes packing interesting; dominant strategy (fill rows) obvious.

ideas.name: Overrun
ideas.pitch: Your blocks spread every turn — clear lines before the board fills.
ideas.reason: Spread randomness makes deaths feel unfair.

ideas.name: Loop Pipes
ideas.pitch: Lay pipe tiles; any closed loop vanishes.
ideas.reason: Single-cell tiles lack polyomino tactility; similar 'loop' fantasy is better served by Hollow. Closed in session 2: an alternative core rule; the game keeps exactly one rule (hard constraint).

ideas.name: Ten
ideas.pitch: Make a row's pips add up to exactly ten.
ideas.reason: Arithmetic load; not tactile.

ideas.name: Mix
ideas.pitch: Blue on yellow makes green; one-color lines clear.
ideas.reason: Not colorblind-safe; rules need learning.

ideas.name: Sandwich
ideas.pitch: Flank blocks to flip their color; one-color lines clear.
ideas.reason: Two concepts stacked.

ideas.name: Shade
ideas.pitch: Tall blocks cast shadows you can't build in.
ideas.reason: Needs a paragraph.

ideas.name: Lift
ideas.pitch: Pick up any group of blocks and put it somewhere better.
ideas.new: Pieces come from the board itself; no tray.
ideas.reason: Interesting, but without new input the board never progresses; needs a drip of junk. Closed in session 2: an alternative core rule; the game keeps exactly one rule (hard constraint).

ideas.name: Tilt
ideas.pitch: Tilt the board and every block slides.
ideas.reason: Swipe-everything is 2048/Threes territory.

ideas.name: Outline
ideas.pitch: Drop a piece exactly on its outline for a bonus pop.
ideas.reason: A feature, not a core idea. Possible daily-challenge objective. Closed in session 2: an alternative core rule; the game keeps exactly one rule (hard constraint).

ideas.name: Keyholes
ideas.pitch: Fill a keyhole with the exact shape that fits it.
ideas.reason: Shallow.

ideas.name: Bomb cells
ideas.pitch: Clear through a bomb and it blasts its neighbors.
ideas.reason: Generic power-up; clutter.

ideas.name: Seasons
ideas.pitch: The clearing rule changes every tray.
ideas.reason: Anti-simplicity.

ideas.name: Seesaw
ideas.pitch: Keep the board balanced as you add weight.
ideas.reason: Physics opacity; unfair deaths.

ideas.name: Conveyor
ideas.pitch: Place pieces before the belt carries them away.
ideas.reason: Time pressure contradicts calm, one-handed, interruptible play.

ideas.name: Echo
ideas.pitch: Every piece you place comes back two turns later.
ideas.reason: Fails one-move gate; but 'you know the future' is a nice planning hook. Closed in session 2: an alternative core rule; the game keeps exactly one rule (hard constraint).

ideas.name: Silhouette
ideas.pitch: Fill the outline exactly with these pieces.
ideas.reason: Exists (packing puzzles).

ideas.name: Flip Puzzle
ideas.pitch: Use these pieces to wipe the pattern clean.
ideas.new: Polyomino XOR stamps; order-free, provably solvable by construction.
ideas.reason: Puzzle mode of I-003; evaluated with it.

ideas.name: Hollow Daily Puzzle
ideas.pitch: Clear the whole board with today's pieces.
ideas.new: Fixed seed + fixed pieces + solver-graded par.
ideas.reason: Merged into I-074.

ideas.name: Two Layers
ideas.pitch: Build a second floor on top of the first.
ideas.reason: Readability on a phone is poor.

ideas.name: Lanterns
ideas.pitch: Light every dark cell with as few lanterns as you can.
ideas.reason: It's Akari.

ideas.name: Lasso
ideas.pitch: Draw a loop around blocks to clear them.
ideas.reason: Drawing on touch is imprecise; Hollow captures the loop fantasy with a cleaner verb. Closed in session 2: an alternative core rule; the game keeps exactly one rule (hard constraint).

ideas.name: Fuse
ideas.pitch: Same-color blocks melt together; big ones pop.
ideas.reason: Merge genre is crowded.

ideas.name: Dominoes
ideas.pitch: Match touching pips to clear dominoes.
ideas.reason: Existing game.

ideas.name: Trail
ideas.pitch: Dragging a piece leaves a trail that becomes blocks.
ideas.reason: Punishes the exploratory dragging that makes drag-and-drop feel good.

ideas.name: Level Ground
ideas.pitch: Each block raises the ground; flatten a row to clear it.
ideas.reason: Height readability is hard top-down; paragraph-ish. Closed in session 2: an alternative core rule; the game keeps exactly one rule (hard constraint).

ideas.name: Mirror Duel
ideas.pitch: Your pieces go on your side; the bot's pieces go on its side.
ideas.reason: Not single-player minimal.

ideas.name: Hollow + Lines
ideas.pitch: Fill a line or close a loop to clear.
ideas.reason: Measured: adding line clears makes Hollow trivially endless (greedy 100% capped) and dilutes novelty.

ideas.name: Moat
ideas.pitch: Seal off any space — even against the wall — and it pops.
ideas.new: Edges count as walls; the smaller side of a split clears.
ideas.reason: Measured: far too forgiving (random survives 158 moves), skill 3.2×; hidden "largest region" rule.

ideas.name: Countdown Cells
ideas.pitch: Cover a numbered cell before it hits zero.
ideas.reason: Pressure mechanic; clutter.

ideas.name: Magnet Wall
ideas.pitch: Clears pull everything toward the magnet.
ideas.reason: Merged into I-011 (Collapse).

ideas.name: Orbit
ideas.pitch: The board rotates a notch after each tray.
ideas.reason: Equivalent to rotating pieces; disorienting.

ideas.name: Laser Rows
ideas.pitch: A full row fires a laser that hits the first block in each column.
ideas.reason: Two-step rule; low readability.

ideas.name: Snap Apart
ideas.pitch: Tap a tray piece to split it in two.
ideas.reason: Two verbs; reduces constraint.

ideas.name: Fog
ideas.pitch: You only see the board near your last piece.
ideas.reason: Unfair by design.

ideas.name: Stripes
ideas.pitch: Rows clear when their colors alternate.
ideas.reason: Colorblind-hostile; rare clears.

ideas.name: Sinkers
ideas.pitch: Heavy pieces fall, light ones float.
ideas.reason: Hidden property per piece.

ideas.name: Teaching tray
ideas.pitch: The very first tray always lets you close a loop in two moves.
ideas.new: Rule taught by a seeded first deal + ghost hint, no text.
ideas.reason: Required for Hollow's R2 (learn in one move).

ideas.name: Difficulty ramp
ideas.pitch: Pieces get chunkier the longer you survive.
ideas.new: Ramp tuned by bots to a target session length.
ideas.reason: Hollow is too forgiving without it (search never dies).

ideas.name: Next-tray peek
ideas.pitch: Show faint silhouettes of the next tray.
ideas.reason: Clutter, and it shifts the game from read-the-board to read-the-queue; Block Blast proves the 3-piece tray is enough.

ideas.name: One undo
ideas.pitch: Undo your last placement once per game.
ideas.reason: Removes the weight of each placement, the core tension. Never in classic.

ideas.name: Daily share grid
ideas.pitch: Share your daily as a tiny emoji picture of your biggest lagoon.
ideas.new: Spoiler-free social proof shaped by our mechanic.
ideas.reason: Wordle-style virality; the lagoon shape is unique per player.

ideas.name: Near-miss bar
ideas.pitch: Game-over card shows how close you got to your best.
ideas.reason: Cheap and proven retention lever.

ideas.name: Seal tick
ideas.pitch: A tiny haptic+sound the moment your drag would seal a lagoon.
ideas.new: The preview is felt, not just seen.
ideas.reason: Highest value/effort polish: teaches the rule through the finger.

ideas.name: Dim misfits
ideas.pitch: Tray pieces that fit nowhere fade out.
ideas.reason: Makes the fail state foreseeable (R13).

ideas.name: Lagoon fish
ideas.pitch: Big lagoons get a little fish that leaps out when they pop.
ideas.reason: Charm; scales with lagoon size so big loops feel alive.

ideas.name: Tap-to-place
ideas.pitch: Tap a piece, then tap a cell, as an alternative to dragging.
ideas.reason: Accessibility option; dragging stays the default.

ideas.name: Clear-the-reef puzzles
ideas.pitch: Hand-checked daily puzzle: clear a set board with fixed pieces.
ideas.new: Finite, solver-graded puzzles from our rule.
ideas.reason: Second mode with Meowdoku-style completion; merges I-042.
ideas.data: 120 solver-verified reefs (~0.18 s each to generate+grade); hardest needs merging two clusters into two lagoons with one piece.

ideas.name: Ambient sea
ideas.pitch: Soft procedural wave bed under the SFX.
ideas.reason: Generative synthesized music + wave ambience with its own toggle.

ideas.name: Points peek
ideas.pitch: While dragging over a big capture, show its points next to the ghost.
ideas.new: Lets you weigh pinch vs lagoon before releasing.
ideas.reason: Shown only for lagoons of 3+, so pinches stay clean.

ideas.name: Reef of the day
ideas.pitch: One shared reef puzzle per day with its own streak.
ideas.new: Daily puzzle cadence for the puzzle audience.
ideas.reason: Built inside the reef grid (no new menu item); counts toward the daily streak.

ideas.name: No-hint marks
ideas.pitch: Reefs cleared without a hint get a distinct mark.
ideas.reason: Cheap mastery marker.

ideas.name: Streak haptics
ideas.pitch: Capture haptics grow stronger as your streak builds.
ideas.reason: Small, nice.

ideas.name: Puzzle undo
ideas.pitch: Step back one placement in a reef puzzle.
ideas.reason: Reefs are ≤3 moves; Restart is already a full undo with less UI.

ideas.name: Best moment card
ideas.pitch: Game-over card shows your biggest lagoon as a little picture.
ideas.reason: Pairs with the share picture.

ideas.name: Living atoll
ideas.pitch: Your best lagoons grow a little island collection on the home screen.
ideas.reason: Merged into the Beach Journal (ADR 0007): the collection with a face.

ideas.name: Tide dots
ideas.pitch: Three dots show how many dry moves your streak has left.
ideas.reason: Fixes a hidden rule (streak grace).

ideas.name: Last-chance wobble
ideas.pitch: Pieces that can't fit shake 'no' before game over.
ideas.new: The loss reads at a glance.
ideas.reason: Fair-fail legibility.

ideas.name: Second lesson
ideas.pitch: After your first pinch, the next hint suggests a 2-cell lagoon.
ideas.reason: Second lesson hint until the first 2+ cell lagoon, then a one-time chip.

ideas.name: Colorblind audit
ideas.pitch: Simulate deuteranopia/protanopia on every skin; flag pairs that collide.
ideas.reason: Colors are cosmetic, but piece identity still benefits.
ideas.data: Pebble deutan min ΔE 3.9 (lagoon vs orchid) → 11.3 after darkening orchid; Glyph ≥16 under all CVDs.

ideas.name: Best-crossing moment
ideas.pitch: The instant you pass your best, a callout and chime — mid-game, once.
ideas.new: Rewards the chase at the moment it happens.
ideas.reason: Proven retention beat; cheap.

ideas.name: Goal levels
ideas.pitch: Short levels with a target: capture a 6-cell lagoon within 15 moves.
ideas.reason: Reef puzzles + journal hints already give finite goals; a level map would add a screen.

ideas.name: Beach Journal
ideas.pitch: Every lagoon catches beach creatures tied to its shape; collect all 47.
ideas.new: Shape-tied species turn the collection into a depth tutor.
ideas.reason: ADR 0007; tuned with bots so the journal takes weeks.

ideas.name: Weekly tide goals
ideas.pitch: Three small goals a week (catch a seahorse, make a 6-lagoon…).
ideas.reason: Journal hints already act as goals; quests add a screen and pressure.

ideas.name: Welcome back
ideas.pitch: On launch, a quiet toast with your live streak.
ideas.reason: No push notifications (privacy); a toast is enough.

ideas.name: Push reminders
ideas.pitch: Daily streak reminder notifications.
ideas.reason: Needs permissions and native plumbing; conflicts with the no-data, calm stance. Revisit only if the owner wants it.

ideas.name: Large text
ideas.pitch: A setting that scales menus and canvas text.
ideas.reason: Larger text setting: canvas text ×1.25, menus zoom 1.12.

ideas.name: Cell-cursor mode
ideas.pitch: Play with a keyboard/switch cursor over cells, with spoken previews.
ideas.reason: Big effort; only worth it with real demand.

ideas.name: Erase my data
ideas.pitch: Settings: erase all progress (two taps).
ideas.reason: Matches the no-data privacy stance.

ideas.name: Leaderboards
ideas.pitch: Game Center / Play Games best-score boards.
ideas.reason: Blocked on the owner: needs developer accounts and Game Center / Play Games setup; would also change the no-data policy (opt-in).

ideas.name: Creature style guide
ideas.pitch: One construction kit (eyes, blush, ink outline, palette) every species follows.
ideas.new: A cohesive cast drawn in code.
ideas.reason: Session 3 art overhaul foundation.

ideas.name: Size classes
ideas.pitch: XS shrimp → XXL kraken: real relative scale in leaps, journal and reveal.
ideas.new: Scale tells rarity and character at a glance.
ideas.reason: Owner ask.

ideas.name: Idle personalities
ideas.pitch: Each species has its own idle: hermit peeks, octopus wiggles, ray glides, puffer inflates.
ideas.reason: Owner ask.

ideas.name: Expressions
ideas.pitch: Idle, happy (caught), surprised (new), sleepy (night) faces.
ideas.reason: Owner ask.

ideas.name: Blink & breathe
ideas.pitch: Every creature blinks every 2–5 s and breathes 2%.

ideas.name: Journal tile art
ideas.pitch: Each tile: creature at its size class on a habitat-tinted card; rarity frame.

ideas.name: Golden shimmer
ideas.pitch: Golden variants: moving specular band + sparkles, not a flat tint.

ideas.name: Creature sprite cache
ideas.pitch: Pre-render each species per size/expression to offscreen canvases; animate transforms only.

ideas.name: Creature of the day
ideas.pitch: Journal header features one found creature with its flavor line.
ideas.new: Daily reason to open the journal.

ideas.name: Silhouette quiz
ideas.pitch: Unfound tiles are true silhouettes that read at 24 px; hints below.

ideas.name: Combo counter
ideas.pitch: COMBO ×N callout escalates with consecutive sealing moves (our streak), breaks after 3 dry moves.
ideas.new: Block Blast's best hook, on our rule.
ideas.reason: Measured: farming pinches scores half of greedy; not exploitable.

ideas.name: Praise ladder
ideas.pitch: Nice! → Lovely Lagoon! → Atoll! → Tidal! by move value; cascades and multi-lagoons get their own words.

ideas.name: Ring burst physics
ideas.pitch: Ring pebbles pop outward with spin, gravity and fade; bigger rings burst harder.

ideas.name: Combo pitch ladder
ideas.pitch: Capture chime climbs a pentatonic step per combo level; layers add at ×5, ×10.

ideas.name: Combo meter
ideas.pitch: Thin meter under the score shows combo and grace (3 pips drain on dry moves).

ideas.name: Combo break
ideas.pitch: Gentle deflate + "Combo 12" fades when it breaks; no punishment sound.

ideas.name: NEW HIGH SCORE moment
ideas.pitch: Mid-game crossing: gold sweep + NEW BEST banner once; game over: big score count-up with confetti foam.

ideas.name: Spotless board clear
ideas.pitch: Whole-board clear: tide wash across the board, giant SPOTLESS!, extra creature.

ideas.name: Hit stop
ideas.pitch: 40–60 ms freeze before a big burst.

ideas.name: Haptic layering
ideas.pitch: Haptic pattern per tier: tick, medium, heavy double, heavy triple for Atoll+cascade.

ideas.name: Score count-up
ideas.pitch: Score rolls up with ease-out; digits pop on big moves.

ideas.name: Rejected: full-screen flashes
ideas.pitch: White flashes on big combos.
ideas.reason: Seizure risk and breaks calm identity; use additive glow at night only.

ideas.name: Rejected: combo timer in seconds
ideas.pitch: Real-time timer for combos.
ideas.reason: Time pressure contradicts no-time-limit accessibility promise.

ideas.name: Discovery reveal
ideas.pitch: New species: board dims, card flips open with the creature dancing, name in display type, rarity rays.
ideas.reason: Owner ask.

ideas.name: Rarity-scaled reveal
ideas.pitch: Common: chip; uncommon: card; rare: rays; epic: rays + music sting; legendary: full-screen tide + fanfare.
ideas.new: Rarer = bigger, never slower than 2.5 s.

ideas.name: Discovery share card
ideas.pitch: A share image: creature, name, rarity, where it was caught, date.

ideas.name: Journal stamp
ideas.pitch: After reveal the entry stamps into the journal with a thump.

ideas.name: First-catch sizes
ideas.pitch: Reveal shows the size vs a reference (a shell) with record badge.

ideas.name: Rejected: paid lures
ideas.pitch: Buy bait for rare species.
ideas.reason: Pay-to-win; violates ADR 0008.

ideas.name: Daily leaderboard
ideas.pitch: Everyone plays the same deal; board resets at UTC midnight.
ideas.reason: Owner ask.

ideas.name: Endless all-time + week
ideas.pitch: Two time spans; week gives fresh chances.

ideas.name: Just-above-you target
ideas.pitch: Show the next name to beat and the gap.

ideas.name: Arcade name entry
ideas.pitch: 7 letters, A–Z only, stylized display.

ideas.name: Replay-verified scores
ideas.pitch: Server replays the move log with the core.

ideas.name: Ghost of the leader
ideas.pitch: Watch the daily #1 replay after you finish.
ideas.new: Learn from the best (replays are free).

ideas.name: Rejected: friend boards via contacts
ideas.pitch: Import contacts to see friends.
ideas.reason: Needs PII and accounts; against privacy stance.

ideas.name: Endless reefs
ideas.pitch: Reefs generated forever from their index, solver-verified, in a worker.
ideas.reason: Owner ask.

ideas.name: Reef chapters
ideas.pitch: 20 reefs per named chapter with progress and a chapter-complete moment.

ideas.name: Depth meter
ideas.pitch: Total reefs cleared shown as depth below the surface.

ideas.name: Signature reefs
ideas.pitch: Every 10th reef is a showpiece (bigger, a cascade, a shape).

ideas.name: Rejected: reef stars by moves
ideas.pitch: 3-star ratings by move count.
ideas.reason: Puzzles have a fixed piece count; stars would be meaningless. ★ = no hints stays.

ideas.name: Display font
ideas.pitch: A licensed rounded display face for scores, callouts and names.

ideas.name: Custom icon set
ideas.pitch: Inline SVG icons on one grid and stroke.

ideas.name: Spring buttons
ideas.pitch: Buttons squish on press with a spring and a soft tick.

ideas.name: Sheet transitions
ideas.pitch: Menus slide up with a spring; backdrop blur.

ideas.name: Results screen redesign
ideas.pitch: Score hero, best delta, combo max, catches row, primary CTA.

ideas.name: Title screen with wordmark + big Play
ideas.pitch: Calm lagoon title, 'Lagooner Beach' wordmark, one large Play button.
ideas.new: A living lagoon behind the title, drawn by the same renderer.
ideas.reason: Owner ask; ADR 0015.

ideas.name: Play button shows what you'll resume
ideas.pitch: Play reads 'Continue' with the mode and score when a saved game exists.
ideas.new: One tap resumes exactly where you were.
ideas.reason: Removes a menu step for returning players.

ideas.name: Skip the intro on deep links
ideas.pitch: ?mode=daily / share links / ?seed open straight into the board.
ideas.new: The intro never blocks a share link.
ideas.reason: Owner constraint.

ideas.name: Skip the intro on quick returns
ideas.pitch: Back within 30 minutes (or resumed from background) goes straight to the board.
ideas.new: Fast players never see it twice in a session.
ideas.reason: Owner: never in the way of a fast player.

ideas.name: Tap anywhere to play
ideas.pitch: Any tap on the title scene (not just the button) starts.
ideas.reason: Conflicts with the quiet About link and accidental taps on launch; the big button is enough.

ideas.name: Play-tap water chime
ideas.pitch: Synthesized droplet + soft major-third chime on Play.
ideas.reason: Owner ask: a sound on the play tap.

ideas.name: Title scene creatures drift by
ideas.pitch: One or two already-caught species swim across the title lagoon.
ideas.new: Your journal shows up on the title screen.
ideas.reason: Lovely if cheap; drawn from the lazy art chunk only when loaded.

ideas.name: Day/Night title by theme
ideas.pitch: Title palette follows the Day/Night theme; Night gets stars and moonlit water.

ideas.name: Wordmark draw-on animation
ideas.pitch: Letters fade/rise in on cold launch (once), still under reduced motion.
ideas.reason: Reduced motion: no movement, instant.

ideas.name: Intro 'Daily' chip
ideas.pitch: A small Daily chip under Play showing today's state (played/streak).
ideas.reason: Keep the title to Play + quiet links; Daily lives one tap away in the menu. Extra choices slow a fast player.

ideas.name: Logo splash before title
ideas.pitch: A studio-logo splash before the title.
ideas.reason: Anti-pattern: an unskippable wall before play.

ideas.name: Login / account on title
ideas.pitch: Sign in to sync.
ideas.reason: No accounts by design; privacy.

ideas.name: Native splash hands off to the title
ideas.pitch: Native splash colour matches the title background so launch feels seamless.
ideas.new: No flash between native splash and web title.

ideas.name: Dedicated display face for the wordmark
ideas.pitch: Subset a display font to just the wordmark glyphs.
ideas.reason: Font picked in TITLE_TYPE.md / ADR 0013.

ideas.name: Hand-lettered SVG wordmark
ideas.pitch: Draw the wordmark as custom SVG paths.
ideas.reason: Higher effort, harder to iterate; an OFL display face subset is cheaper and accessible as real text.

ideas.name: Script font wordmark
ideas.pitch: Use a brush/script face.
ideas.reason: Thin scripts read poorly at small sizes and feel generic.

ideas.name: Coral & rock block materials
ideas.pitch: Each colour becomes a real material: brain coral, sea glass, basalt…
ideas.new: Materials stay identified by hue first, texture second.
ideas.reason: Owner ask; ADR 0014.

ideas.name: Procedural material sprites
ideas.pitch: Draw materials procedurally into the existing per-size sprite cache.
ideas.reason: Bundle- and perf-safe; ADR 0014.

ideas.name: Bitmap texture atlas for blocks
ideas.pitch: Painted textures in an atlas.
ideas.reason: Asset weight, blur at dpr 3, and day/night needs double atlases.

ideas.name: Per-cell variation
ideas.pitch: Each cell picks one of several variants so a wall doesn't tile.
ideas.reason: Existing variant slot.

ideas.name: Wet sheen on fresh blocks
ideas.pitch: A placed block glints wet for a moment.

ideas.name: Coral polyps open in a lagoon ring
ideas.pitch: Ring blocks bristle just before they pop.
ideas.reason: Risk of busy normal moves.

ideas.name: Pop debris matches material
ideas.pitch: Ring bursts spit sand, coral chips or glass flecks by material.
ideas.reason: Only if the burst stays readable.

ideas.name: Sea-glass translucency
ideas.pitch: Sea-glass block is frosted and lets the board show through a touch.

ideas.name: Barnacles on old blocks
ideas.pitch: Blocks that sit for many moves grow barnacles.
ideas.reason: Adds state to the board view; noise in the colourblind audit.

ideas.name: Shape-glyph on materials (Glyph style)
ideas.pitch: Glyph accessibility style keeps its symbols over the new materials.
ideas.reason: Accessibility must not regress.

ideas.name: Habitat requirement line
ideas.pitch: Each journal habitat header shows how to find its creatures.
ideas.new: Copy comes from the same spec as the catch rules.
ideas.reason: Built (S5): HABITAT_REQ in src/meta/reqText.ts; lines generated from the members' req and proved true (journalReq.test.ts).

ideas.name: Per-habitat progress
ideas.pitch: '3/7' and a tick per habitat.
ideas.reason: Built (S5): got/total, a success tick and 'complete' for screen readers; Golden x/n once complete.

ideas.name: Rarity progress row
ideas.pitch: Caught per rarity tier.
ideas.reason: Built (S5): summary block above the habitats, pips + found/total per tier.

ideas.name: Golden progress
ideas.pitch: Golden variants found / total with the 1-in-64 rule.
ideas.reason: Built (S5): 'Golden x/47 · 1 in 64 …' from catch.ts GOLDEN_ODDS (a statistical test pins the rate).

ideas.name: Spoiler-free hints
ideas.pitch: Undiscovered species keep silhouettes + the vague hint; no exact shapes.
ideas.reason: Built (S5): silhouettes + ??? kept; the hint is generated from the rule (names the pool, never the creature). It is exact about shape and size, not vague: the research found vague copy drifting from the rules.

ideas.name: Requirement/rule property test
ideas.pitch: Each species' catch condition implies its habitat requirement.
ideas.new: Copy can never drift from rules.
ideas.reason: Built (S5): gate implication over an enumerated context space, plus req ≡ the old lambdas for all 47.

ideas.name: Hint ladder for long-missing species
ideas.pitch: After N lagoons without a catch, the hint sharpens.
ideas.reason: Changes the feel of discovery; post-launch.

ideas.name: Habitat complete stamp
ideas.pitch: A stamp and a small sound when a habitat fills.

ideas.name: Journal completion percent
ideas.pitch: Overall % on the cover.

ideas.name: Exact catch odds in the journal
ideas.pitch: Show each species' percent.
ideas.reason: Turns discovery into a spreadsheet; spoils rare surprises.

ideas.name: Habitat filter tabs
ideas.pitch: Tabs per habitat.
ideas.reason: Six short sections scroll fine; tabs hide progress.

ideas.name: About page: why the ocean
ideas.pitch: A few lines from Lachlan about Laguna's tide pools, tied to the game's creatures.
ideas.reason: Owner ask; ADR 0016.

ideas.name: Charity links
ideas.pitch: 3–5 verified coastal-wildlife charities, system browser, untracked.
ideas.reason: CHARITIES.md.

ideas.name: No-funding pledge
ideas.pitch: 'I will not take any funding.' stated plainly.
ideas.reason: Owner ask.

ideas.name: Tip jar
ideas.pitch: Optional tip IAP.
ideas.reason: Contradicts no funding.

ideas.name: Supporter Pack
ideas.pitch: Cosmetic IAP (ADR 0008).
ideas.reason: Contradicts no funding; ADR 0008 superseded.

ideas.name: Donation matching
ideas.pitch: Pledge to match donations.
ideas.reason: A financial promise we can't verify or keep in an app; also 'funding'-adjacent.

ideas.name: Real-world creature facts
ideas.pitch: Species page gets one true fact and the real animal's status.
ideas.reason: Needs careful fact-checking per species.

ideas.name: Beach clean-up reminder
ideas.pitch: A gentle seasonal note linking to Coastal Cleanup Day.
ideas.reason: Push-like nudge; keep the game quiet.

ideas.name: About reachable from Settings
ideas.pitch: The About page is also in Settings › About.

ideas.name: Share the About page
ideas.pitch: Share sheet for the charity list.
ideas.reason: Not asked; keep it modest.

ideas.name: Charity logos
ideas.pitch: Show each charity's logo.
ideas.reason: Trademark use + asset weight; names + one line read better.

ideas.name: Donate link affordance
ideas.pitch: Each link shows its host (e.g. pacificmmc.org) and an 'opens in browser' icon.

ideas.name: Charity link e2e
ideas.pitch: e2e asserts every About link matches CHARITIES.md.

ideas.name: Material visual baselines
ideas.pitch: Pixel baselines for every block material, Day and Night, 3 sizes.

ideas.name: Intro skip e2e
ideas.pitch: e2e: cold launch shows intro; deep link and quick return skip it.

ideas.name: Intro perf budget
ideas.pitch: Title scene frame cost stays under the draw budget.

ideas.name: Title in store screenshot
ideas.pitch: The first store frame shows the title screen.

ideas.name: Eligible-chances counter
ideas.pitch: Undiscovered tiles show 'Close: 3 chances' (lagoons that met the rule), Hades-style, no odds.
ideas.new: Progress toward an unknown without a spoiler
ideas.reason: Needs a journal save-format field (chances[id]) and a migration; skipped for the v1.0.0 RC (S5). JOURNAL_REQUIREMENTS.md §3.4. Session 6: still backlog — needs a journal save-format change (new validated field + migration); not worth the risk for the RC.

ideas.name: Legendary pill vs new dot
ideas.pitch: On epic/legendary journal tiles the 'new' dot sits on the rarity word; move it beside the pill.
ideas.reason: Session 6: on epic/legendary tiles the new dot sits on the frame corner, ringed in the page colour, clear of the word pill.
